output.reason: I find this convincing because the Tallis setpoint error fits every data point I have: K1 sailed on Meridane before Tallis went live and passed, every Meridane container booked through Tallis failed, and every Coastway container passed, including those packed with the new fungicide. The next steps are concrete and urgent, though I haven't seen the 7°C evidence myself and would want the controller downloads to confirm it.
